dedupe_keys.name: long term performance assessment of base isolated buildings through field testing eries pasfit

description: PASFIT records static and dynamic tests on an existing base-isolated building constructed after the 2009 L'Aquila earthquake and isolated for approximately fifteen years. The three-storey structure rests on a concrete slab supported by 32 bearings. The experiment investigates ageing, device variability and interaction between the isolation system and surrounding structure. The dataset is provided by EUCENTRE-IUSS mobile system MOBILAB through BED. The structured experiment dates run from 2024-03-01 to 2024-10-31. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives, CAD files. BED displays download links with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
